gbm_population_evidence.quote: Recurrent Glioblastoma; Recurrent Astrocytoma; Recurrent Oligodendroglioma; Recurrent Glioma
Patients must have histologically proven high-grade gliomas - GBM, Astrocytoma, or Oligodendroglioma (glioma WHO Grade III or IV) that is now recurrent by MRI or surgical pathology.

candidate_evidence.quote: Phase II Trial of Niraparib in Patients With Recurrent Glioma

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Phase II Trial of Niraparib in Patients With Recurrent Glioma

role_evidence.quote: Patients will be treated with individualized starting dose of Niraparib.

biomarkers.biomarker_other: myChoice molecular assay (tumour genomic profiling; target not stated in record)

source_quote.quote: a fresh biopsy of recurrent or persistent tumor must be obtained for molecular assay by myChoice test (Myriad Genetics) prior to study treatment initiation.

coder_notes: The myChoice assay is required as a tissue/testing step but the record states no result-based entry requirement or cohort, so it is not coded eligibility or enrichment. The record does not name the assay target.
